searchQuery.title: Search Query
searchQuery.description: Product name, keyword, or ingredient to search for on Amazon (e.g. "whey protein").

maxProducts.title: Maximum Products
maxProducts.description: Maximum number of products to scrape across all search-result pages.

minimumSales.title: Minimum Sales
minimumSales.description: Minimum sales_numeric (from Amazon's own "bought in past month" indicator) required to pass the filter. Leave default if unsure.

minimumRating.title: Minimum Rating
minimumRating.description: Minimum star rating (out of 5) required to pass the filter.

minimumReviews.title: Minimum Reviews
minimumReviews.description: Minimum review count required to pass the filter.

maximumReviews.title: Maximum Reviews
maximumReviews.description: Maximum review count allowed to pass the filter.
